crown: Classify by the body's governing achievement, not by one reusable organ or the folder in which a copy was found.
laws: A secondary use may create a bridge, but it may not replace the body's primary seat.
A higher version number does not automatically own source, operating, device-proof and frozen-anchor authority.
Parallel branches remain parallel when their behaviour, purpose or proof lanes differ.
A public-safe catalogue may summarize a body, but it may not demote or rename the body's governing achievement.
Current-best claims require a source route, role, proof lane and recovery route.
No flagship accomplishment may be reduced to a weak card while its evidence ladder remains buried elsewhere.
